"snippet": "I extracted and inspected /mnt/data/training.zip.
What’s actually inside

4,343 files

All are *.link.txt pointer files (each file contains a single absolute Android path like /storage/emulated/0/...)

No actual PDFs/DOCs/PPTs are included in this ZIP — it’s an index of references, not the training content itself.

That’s the main reason it “feels like junk” when you open it anywhere except the original phone/filesystem.

Worthwhile vs junk (best-effort classification)
